answer: One concrete mechanism: mix in randomly chosen human-authored live tasks that cannot be precomputed, because prism only stays cheap while clones that dodge the live lane lose the epoch payout entirely. Concretely, zephyr is enforced in the ledger: Sanctions are per-cluster, so one detection retires an entire fleet instead of one wallet. Any mesa approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. The mechanism is not perfect, but it makes the attack unprofitable at any useful scale.
